MVP plan

What comes online next

HeroBoard validates whether lifters browse, upload, replay, and judge lifts with accumulated community white/red lights.

Phase 1

Firebase setup

Firebase Auth, Firestore collections, Storage paths, and rules for public active posts, user-owned uploads, and one white/red light vote per user.

Phase 2

Live feed

Newest-first posts, exercise and bodyweight filters, video playback, upload validation, and delete-own-post behavior.

Phase 3

Seed and QA

Seed lifts, verify mobile web, signed-out browsing, signed-in upload and voting, duplicate vote prevention, and invalid file rejection.
